title: Install reusable furniture sliders and move a side table
instruction:
Fit a reusable slider under each leg, then slide the table into the outlined destination.
Leave it standing on all four sliders and let go.
setup: A 350 x 350 x 350 mm LACK-style side table, estimated 1.8 kg, with 50 mm square feet at 300 mm centre spacing and a 30 mm tabletop. Four separate round reusable sliders are 88.9 mm in diameter, estimated 13 mm thick and 20 g each: 9 mm cushioned upper face (86 mm usable diameter), 2 mm plastic backing and 2 mm felt underneath. A secured 800 x 1100 x 10 mm polyurethane-oak panel rests on the stock YAM station table, with cutouts around the unchanged arm mounts. In station coordinates, the panel top is z=0.7575 m; the table starts bare-footed at (x,y)=(0.320,0) m. Loose sliders start foam-up at (0.170,+/-0.280) and (0.340,+/-0.280) m. A flat, noncolliding 400 mm square destination is centred at (0.520,0) m. Both stock arms start in their native ready pose. Recording adds two fixed oblique evidence cameras at (1.05,+/-0.35,0.96) m aimed at (0.42,0,0.79) m; neither is a model input.
scoring: Final credit: 0.1 per foot on a distinct slider, up to 0.4. Each foot corner is at least 2 mm inside the usable foam edge; stationary foot-to-pad and pad-to-floor gaps are within +/-0.5 mm. Pads are within 5 degrees and table within 3 degrees of upright; feet on panel; grippers 50 mm clear; no robot support; 2 seconds still within 2 mm and 1 degree. Full score 1.0 also needs the entire tabletop inside the goal and 150 mm net displacement in a continuous visually retained segment through final settling. Throughout transport, each foot-base centre stays within 20 mm horizontally of the same distinct pad centre and within 10 mm of nominal resting height (panel plus slider thickness); pad underside centres stay within 10 mm of panel height; table/pads stay within 15 degrees of upright and foot footprints on panel. Any failed check or pairing change resets the segment. Transport uses these video-observable limits, not submillimetre gaps. Carrying/upending before the segment is allowed.
run_limit: 6000 control actions at 20 Hz (300 seconds), including all positioning and installation.
fidelity: 350 mm table and 88.9 mm sliders; mass, construction and friction estimated. Foam is rigid and uncalibrated. Continuous floor; contact-only furniture/pads. Stock YAM geometry, gains, limits and 14D actions. One fixed-layout demo passed at 480 Hz; doubled-rate insertion failed alignment. Transport uses a centimetre-scale visual retention proxy, not continuous contact metrology. Numerical convergence and real-product fidelity are not established.
scores: Dream-1 (dreamlabs/dream-1-beta): 0.0 in 6000 actions; fresh continuous scripted demo: 1.0 in 5838. Both independently rescored under v2. Original model episode/video preserved; SDK sessions renewed 124 times. No new paid model attempt.
context: Install reusable floor protectors on a full-size household side table, then move it on those supports. The installation and transport depend on two different contact interfaces: the foot stays on the cushioned upper face while the felt underside slides over the finished floor.
reset_notes: Reusable objects; restore the bare-footed table, four loose foam-up pads and stock ready arm poses to the stated layout. No consumed materials.
